title.romaji: Tensei Shitara Dai Nana Ouji Datta node, Kimamani Majutsu wo Kiwamemasu 2nd Season
title.english: I Was Reincarnated as the 7th Prince so I Can Take My Time Perfecting My Magical Ability Season 2
title.native: 転生したら第七王子だったので、気ままに魔術を極めます 第2期

synonyms: 轉生為第七王子，隨心所欲的魔法學習之路 第二季
description:
After a victorious battle against Guisarme in the Lordost region, Lloyd’s pursuit of magic knows no bounds. His next goal? Holy Magic! To learn this sacred art, Lloyd and his companions visit a church, but what awaits them there…?

(Source: I Was Reincarnated as the 7th Prince so I Can Take My Time Perfecting My Magical Ability Official Site)

node.description:
[Lloyd](https://anilist.co/character/290877/de-Saloum-Lloyd)'s loyal maid, who serves the Kingdom of Saloum. In charge of his education and his protection. Has mastery with a blade that adventurers envy, along with the alias "The Silver Blade Princess." Seems very kind at first, but rigorous when it comes to training with a sword. She was a cold-hearted swordswoman in the past, and during battle that side of her surfaces. 

(Source: Official Site)

The seventh prince of the royal family that rules the Kingdom of Saloum. He was reincarnated and grows up with the memories of his previous life as a sorcerer. Although he's only ten years old, he has an enormous amount of sorcery knowledge and possesses mana that even terrifies demons. He's not interested in things such as succession to the throne, girls, or romance. Instead, his activities and desires are all focused on the research of his beloved sorcery and its practice. 

(Source: Official Site)

A martial artist that uses a foreign breathing method that gives access to superhuman abilities, known as “Qi”. After a life dedicated wholly to training, she fled her dojo to become an adventurer in pursuit of a fateful meeting with a handsome man. However, she had little luck with finding adventuring comrades, and encounters Lloyd while traveling on her own. Has a weakness for pretty faces, with a cheerful and excited disposition. 

(Source: I Was Reincarnated as the 7th Prince so I Can Take My Time Perfecting My Magical Ability Official Site)

Part of the Assassins Guild, whose members all have bounties on their heads. Members of this guild are all born with a condition affecting their mana, known as “The Blighted”, and in Ren's case she is able to secrete poison through her skin, earning her the name "Ren the Poison Moth." Normally wears heavy clothing, and when her skin is exposed she is capable of spreading poison around an area. A bit of a tomboy, who has a shy personality thanks to her power. 

(Source: Official Site)

The Pain Blighted, whose ability allows her to link with anyone she sees, at which point she and her target will share any injuries either suffers. Given the nature of her power, she often harms herself as a tactic in battle, earning her the name "Talia the Hundred Pains." She has a self-sacrificing personality where she will endure pain willingly for the sake of her friends. She loves gossip, and often takes care of Ren as the only other girl in the guild. 

(Source: I Was Reincarnated as the 7th Prince so I Can Take My Time Perfecting My Magical Ability Official Site)

A demon who uses the old magic and once drove the Kingdom of Saloum into the verge of collapse. After being sealed inside of a forbidden tome that was locked away in the kingdom's sealed archive for several centuries, he's released by Lloyd and they have their first encounter. But he becomes overwhelmed by Lloyd's immeasurable mana and sorcery and surrenders to him. After that, he turns into a cute familiar and serves Lloyd. 

(Source: I Was Reincarnated as the 7th Prince so I Can Take My Time Perfecting My Magical Ability Official Site)

After assembling a group of other Blighted, he created the Assassin's Guild, acting as its leader. Known as the Phantom Blighted, his power will teleport him to random locations regardless of his own will. He was originally the third son of the noble family who ruled the territory of Lordost. He formed his team of Blighted in order to oppose his relatives, who dominate Lordost with political power. Kind-hearted and caring, the Assassin’s Guild looks to him for their direction, until... 

(Source: I Was Reincarnated as the 7th Prince so I Can Take My Time Perfecting My Magical Ability Official Site)

A kind-hearted nun serving at a church in the Dane district of the Kingdom of Saloum. Renowned for her beautiful singing voice and her ability to heal others, Escher has a past connection with Lloyd.

(Source: I Was Reincarnated as the 7th Prince so I Can Take My Time Perfecting My Magical Ability Official Site)

One of the four wild bearwolf monsters that live in the forest. After being doused in Lloyd's magic power he transforms into a white, fluffy form, earning him the name "Shiro." With a keen sense of smell and a massive body, he can transport Lloyd and Sylpha around with ease. 

(Source: I Was Reincarnated as the 7th Prince so I Can Take My Time Perfecting My Magical Ability Official Site)

node.description:
The sixth princess of the Saloum Kingdom, Lloyd's older sister. With her personal maid, Eris, she keeps a menagerie of her favorite animals in the castle's "Boxed Garden Tower", and spends her days leisurely looking after them. A laid-back and absent-minded girl who, much like her brothers, dotes on Lloyd. She possesses a magical power that lets her subconsciously connect with animals and monsters, resulting in even high-level creatures like a lesser fenrir being among her pets. She believes this is purely the result of the affection she shows them 

(Source: I Was Reincarnated as the 7th Prince so I Can Take My Time Perfecting My Magical Ability Official Site)

The Warp Blighted, whose joints are unnaturally flexible, allowing him to fit through even the smallest of spaces, like a rodent, earning him the name "Babylon the Giant Rat." A master of martial arts that utilizes his body's flexibility, he is recognizable by his small eyes that conceal his emotions. During combat he will laugh in a way that antagonizes his enemies. Though he seems aloof, much like the rest of the guild, he cares greatly for his companions, and is known for keeping a cool head, as well being a reliable decision maker.

(Source: I Was Reincarnated as the 7th Prince so I Can Take My Time Perfecting My Magical Ability Official Site)

node.description:
The second prince of the Saloum Kingdom, and one of Lloyd's older brothers. The current heir to the throne with both martial and academic ability. Often at the center of attention in the palace, but lacking in arrogance, he treats his subordinates with care and has earned the backing of many parties. Albert has recognized Lloyd's talent with magic where others have overlooked it, and considers him a potential valuable ally for the future. 

(Source: I Was Reincarnated as the 7th Prince so I Can Take My Time Perfecting My Magical Ability Official Site)

The fourth princess of the Kingdom of Saloum and Lloyd’s older sister. She is deeply knowledgeable about music and has mastered various instruments but shows little interest in anything outside of music. Her performances with Escher are highly acclaimed, enchanting not only people but even the gods. 

(Source: I Was Reincarnated as the 7th Prince so I Can Take My Time Perfecting My Magical Ability Official Site)

With the ability to imbue his words with mana, he is the Curse Blighted. Because anything he says will be affected by his mana, he normally wears a bird-like mask, which has earned him the name "Crow the Dark Raptor." During battle, he uses his Cursed Speech in order to support his comrades. His inability to speak freely, due to his curse, made him seem introverted and gloomy for a long time, but, with Lloyd's help, his powers are now under control, and he seems much more cheerful. 

(Source: I Was Reincarnated as the 7th Prince so I Can Take My Time Perfecting My Magical Ability Official Site)

node.description:
The fourth prince of the Saloum Kingdom, and one of Lloyd's older brothers. While he had a fondness for magic from an early age, due to a lack of talent, at age 10 he chose to pursue blacksmithing instead, traveling to the neighboring kingdom of Bartram for his education in the subject. His dream is to create swords enchanted with magical power, with an eye towards establishing a Magic Swordsman Corps in Saloum. A dedicated craftsman with a rough edge, but a kind heart. 

(Source: I Was Reincarnated as the 7th Prince so I Can Take My Time Perfecting My Magical Ability Official Site)

A priest whom Babylon encounters in the courtyard of the church. Though he has long served the gods, he is curiously prone to forgetting his rosary—an object of deep importance to any clergyman. His true nature remains shrouded in mystery. 

(Source: I Was Reincarnated as the 7th Prince so I Can Take My Time Perfecting My Magical Ability Official Site)

The Web Blighted, who converts the mana that covers his body into a sticky fluid. After Jade returns to his homeland for personal reasons, Galilea finds himself in charge of the Assassin's Guild. He fights by using a combination of his webs and his powerful frame. He understands his teammates personalities well, giving him effective command even during chaotic battles. 

(Source: I Was Reincarnated as the 7th Prince so I Can Take My Time Perfecting My Magical Ability Official Site)

A devout apostle of the 64 Gods of the Celestial Realm and a messenger of the divine. He is a powerful being who wields the strength of the gods and grants the use of Holy Magic, capable of purifying evil. When faced with someone he disapproves of, he unleashes his Divine Armament without hesitation or mercy. Proud and aloof by nature, Jiriel often refers to humans as “fools.” However, when he encounters someone who piques his interest, his demeanor shifts dramatically— responding with excessive intensity and openly displaying his emotions in an almost obsessive manner. 

(Source: I Was Reincarnated as the 7th Prince so I Can Take My Time Perfecting My Magical Ability Official Site)
